episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Kang Pi-o is known around school as an unrivaled talent — until he meets the mysterious Choi Jeong-yo and realizes he may have finally met his match.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: With Jeong-yo now his classmate, a bitter Pi-o keeps his distance. But when the two are tasked with a joint performance, Pi-o finds himself warming up.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: When crisis strikes right before the joint stage, Pi-o improvises a fix — only to wonder if it was a mistake when Jeong-yo's skills outshine his own.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: With Pi-o determined to reclaim his love for music, Jeong-yo shows Pi-o how to have fun on the piano. Jeong-yo's family troubles catch up to him.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Intent on proving himself, Pi-o joins the Prague Harmonie International Competition and asks Jeong-yo to join too. Pi-o's obsessive practice takes a toll.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Years later, Pi-o is successful and world-renowned — but miserable. Hong Jae-in tries to let Pi-o know how she feels. Pi-o hunts down news of Jeong-yo.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Pi-o finds himself stuck deep in a slump, but can't seem to overcome his fears alone. Later, a familiar face suggests collaborating on a performance.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Pi-o faces increasing pressure to do the joint performance, but his issues with the piano only get worse. Jeong-yo finally steps in to help.
